mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE TRUNC(JOIN_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE STATUS_CD IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, O.PAY_AMOUNT AS payAmount, O.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus FROM TB_ORDER O JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = O.MEMBER_NO ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE STATUS_CD = 'WITHDRAWN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER M WHERE M.STATUS_CD <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BUSINESS B WHERE B.BIZ_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND B.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER M WHERE M.STATUS_CD <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BUSINESS B WHERE B.BIZ_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND B.STATUS_CD = 'APPROVED' )

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE), 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=KOREAN') AS dayLabel, NVL(SUM(NVL(O.PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS salesAmount FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 AND TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND O.ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL' GROUP BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) ORDER BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE)

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE), 'FMDD') AS dayLabel, NVL(SUM(NVL(O.PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS salesAmount FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) AND O.ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL' GROUP BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE) ORDER BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE)
SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) AND ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE TRUNC(JOIN_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(JOIN_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(REG_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') AS dayLabel, NVL(SUM(NVL(O.PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS salesAmount FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) AND TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) AND O.ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL' GROUP BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(O.ORDER_DATE, 'MM')

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(M.JOIN_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') AS dayLabel, COUNT(*) AS salesAmount FROM TB_MEMBER M WHERE TRUNC(M.JOIN_DATE, 'MM') >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) AND TRUNC(M.JOIN_DATE, 'MM') < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY TRUNC(M.JOIN_DATE, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(M.JOIN_DATE, 'MM')

SELECT dayLabel, salesAmount FROM ( SELECT '병원' AS dayLabel, COUNT(*) AS salesAmount FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) UNION ALL SELECT '숙소', COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) UNION ALL SELECT '쇼핑', COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) T ORDER BY CASE dayLabel WHEN '병원' THEN 1 WHEN '숙소' THEN 2 WHEN '쇼핑' THEN 3 END
SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(PAY_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND ORDER_STATUS <> 'CANCEL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE TRUNC(JOIN_DATE) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND TRUNC(JOIN_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(REG_DATE) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND TRUNC(REG_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ORDER WHERE TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND TRUNC(ORDER_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
